encounter.scope: Complete production city/airport and real automatic encounters. Region origins, a 90-metre neighbouring relocation and a distant district relocation are fixture setup; walking/driving use production input. Actual V/B events and paid upgrade callbacks. Enemy creation/pursuit remains automatic; no forced damage, altered grace or enemy poses. Parked unused vehicles are frozen. Fixed-step correctness and natural encounter screenshots, not sustained FPS or broad play-balance research.

scope: Windows x86_64 exact release ZIP/PE/PCK integrity, full production-world headless initialization, production Jolt vehicle physics for emergency braking, drift, motorcycle steering, triple-speed boost, release recovery, stationary and airborne input, and independent vehicle state; full-city survival enemy spawning, damage, H/B input, tank projectile rewards and paid fleet repair; natural home/Opera/airport/CBD encounters, pursuit and neighbouring reinforcement while old enemies remain, stale-wave recovery, V/B controls and paid fire-control upgrades, automatic tank support with actual H field repairs. Exported scripts may be compiled resources; external executable/PCK hashes identify the tested build. No GPU rendering, screenshots, human controls, audio listening, FPS benchmark or complete gameplay regression.
save_isolation: Fresh GitHub-hosted VM; per-process APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA redirection requested. Actual driving, survival and encounter report locations are observed and recorded because Windows known-folder resolution may use the runner profile. --interactive-qa, --driving-qa, --survival-qa and --encounter-qa skip slot/settings reads and create unsaved worlds. No existing saves copied, opened or deleted; pre-existing driving, survival or encounter evidence causes failure.
